note: City of Rock Rapids campground in Island Park, on two islands in the Rock River (entrance on North Boone Street). The pads are pull-ins on an inner lane, set back across a lawn from the riverside park road and trail. City pool with water slides next door, fishing, tubing, playgrounds, shelters, rec trail; two cabins. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 (2024 season), 22 electric pads, showers at the pool bathhouse, dump, FCFS envelope self-registration. Not waterfront stands (unsure): the pads are ~50 m from the ~30 m main channel across a lawn and the riverside road/trail, which runs on a berm.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront stands (unsure, no lead). NAIP shows the camper pads as ~8+ parallel gravel pull-ins off an inner lane at ~43.4360,-96.1662. Each pad faces east across ~40 m of mostly open lawn to the riverside park road and trail, riprap, then the Rock River's main channel, ~28-32 m wide here (river by the 30 m rule). Pad ends are ~50 m from the water. The city says the trail 'continues along the top of a berm', and no city photo shows a campsite or a view from one. So a sightline to the water is not shown, and riverview is not earned.
HOOKUPS: 'electrical hookups with water and sewer available' is ambiguous (at the pad, or a fill point and dump?). Water/sewer left unset; no amperage is posted, so electric is left unset too.
FEES: the newest dated rate is the '2024 Camping season' line; the city has not posted a 2025/2026 rate.
DUMP true rests on the general camping rule 'Tank water shall be disposed in the designated dump station areas only'; no dump location is named.
SEASON: none stated by the city. Left unset.

PIN OK (~40 m from the pad row). Website and phone (712) 472-2553 confirmed. The stored website is the Island Park place page; the camping page https://rockrapids.com/to-do-see/camping-cabins/ carries the rates and rules and may be the better link.
FIT: the pull-in pads look ~12-15 m long on NAIP; no length posted.
